harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured daily logrotate for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 with 7 compressed rotations and copytruncate so the application continues writing without a signal. A forced rotation confirmed correct behavior. node1 was rebooted and the config and rotation state survived.
actions_performed: Created /etc/logrotate.d/inventory with: daily, rotate 7, compress, delaycompress, missingok, notifempty, copytruncate
Forced rotation: app.log truncated in place (copytruncate), original content saved as app.log.1
Captured pre-restart boot ID and state
Rebooted node1 safely with deferred reboot command
Verified logrotate config, log files, and rotation state all intact after reboot

evidence.requirement: Baseline: /var/log/inventory/app.log exists, no logrotate config yet
evidence.summary: app.log present with 60 bytes of content, no /etc/logrotate.d/inventory config, no process holding the file open

evidence.requirement: Logrotate config created: daily, rotate 7, compress, delaycompress, missingok, notifempty, copytruncate
evidence.summary: Config written to /etc/logrotate.d/inventory; debug run confirmed correct parsing: daily rotation, 7 rotations kept, empty logs not rotated

evidence.requirement: Rotation works and application can continue writing (copytruncate)
evidence.summary: Force rotation succeeded: app.log truncated to 0 bytes in place (application fd remains valid), original content preserved in app.log.1
Boot ID 19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529; app.log (0 bytes) and app.log.1 (60 bytes) present; logrotate state records last rotation at 2026-09-03 00:26:28
Deferred reboot scheduled (pid=1935), acknowledgement received before disconnect
Two consecutive connection timeouts confirm node was offline during reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: New boot ID 65522f05-831e-4e09-8508-c45ea6926ba2 — differs from pre-restart ID, proving a real reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: config, logs, and rotation state intact
evidence.summary: Logrotate config unchanged, app.log and app.log.1 both present with correct sizes, logrotate state file preserved with correct last-rotation timestamp
